enum Expr[T]:
    BoolLit(value: bool) -> Expr[bool]
    IntLit(value: i64) -> Expr[i64]
    Add(left: Expr[i64], right: Expr[i64]) -> Expr[i64]
    Sub(left: Expr[i64], right: Expr[i64]) -> Expr[i64]
    Scale(value: Expr[i64], factor: i64) -> Expr[i64]
    If[T](cond: Expr[bool], then_value: Expr[T], else_value: Expr[T]) -> Expr[T]

fn eval[T](expr: Expr[T]) -> T:
    match expr:
        Expr.IntLit(value) => value
        Expr.BoolLit(value) => value
        Expr.Add(left, right) => eval(left) + eval(right)
        Expr.Sub(left, right) => eval(left) - eval(right)
        Expr.If(cond, then_value, else_value) =>
            if eval(cond): eval(then_value) else: eval(else_value)

enum Box[T](contents: T):
    IntBox(n: i64) -> Box[i64](n)
    BoolBox(b: bool) -> Box[bool](b)

data Label:
    value: string

impl Display for Label:
    fn to_string(self) -> string: self.value

impl Hash for Label :
    fn hash(self, state: mut Hasher) -> void:
        self.value.hash(state)

fn normalize(values: mut list[string], entries: mut map[string, i32]) -> i32:
    values . append ( "\u{1F600}" )
    clean := values.map(fn(value: string): value.trim().lower())
    removed := entries.remove("old")
    lengths := removed.map(fn(value: i32): value + clean.len())
    match lengths:
        value? => value
        nil => 0

fn report(label: Label) -> void $ Console:
    println(label)

fn fail[T](message: string) -> T:
    panic(message)
